Name: JavaJsb
Description: Disciplined grammar for the Java dialect emitted by the JsonSchemaBuilder (jsb) generator: package declaration, fixed-shape import block, one public class with Jackson-annotated private fields and getter/setter pairs, nested static classes and string-value enums. Hand-authored for the ENFAStepLexer-StepParser engine and validated against the jsb Java generator output (21/21 corpus files).
